symbols.parity: f64 inverse, determinant rejection below 1e-15, accepted affine limits, finite output
matrix, translate, scale, rotate with optional center, skewX/skewY; exact argument counts, right-first affine composition, 64-operation cap, SVG decimal grammar and finite affine limits

missing transform is identity; local transform composes with parent; parse failure is reported at original attribute value start and parent-composition overflow at element name start; both diagnostic positions are asserted
ASCII sign, decimal and exponent grammar; rejects NaN, infinity, incomplete exponents, trailing bytes and absolute values above 1e6
fixed caller-selected count, comma or space/tab/CR/LF separators, no repeated/trailing comma, form-feed separator rejected, bounded to 64 outputs and fallible reserve
unitless/px, pt, mm, cm, in, em and percentage reference conversions; case-insensitive units; invalid percentage reference, unsupported units, overflow and trailing bytes rejected

defer; none; all nine alignments; meet default and slice; only space, tab, CR and LF count as whitespace; form feed is rejected; source is capped at 16 MiB and oversize input returns InvalidArgument at offset 0
none nonuniform scaling, meet/slice uniform scaling, alignment offsets, positive finite viewport dimensions and accepted affine output limits
the reference 22-name unprefixed allowlist; first unsupported or prefixed attribute reports its original name start
required target viewBox and use width/height; use x/y percentages; use aspect overrides target aspect; default centered meet; viewport size and viewBox validation
parent-size defaults, percentage x/y/width/height, zero-size empty result, transformed clip corners, optional viewBox/aspect mapping, child dimensions and parent/local composition
SVG namespace validation, required width/height, [1,4096] viewport bounds, ceil output dimensions, viewBox and preserveAspectRatio defaults

adapter.description: A borrowed original source slice, checked element/name/value spans, optional namespace-prefix span, and a borrowed bounded attribute slice. Lookup is exact and case-sensitive and skips prefixed attributes.
adapter.symbol_mapping_source_rule: target and use lists must refer to the same original source allocation and length so all spans and diagnostics retain document byte offsets

api_adaptations: C token-array lookup becomes a lifetime-bound AttributeList; there is no C/XML token ABI or C shim.
C output pointers and mutable diagnostic structs become Result values carrying typed error kind and absolute byte offset.
Number-list output uses a bounded Vec with try_reserve_exact; no unbounded C-style output array or infallible dynamic allocation is exposed.
An empty nested viewport returns a fully initialized Rust value with empty=true and zeroed clip points; the C caller receives empty=true before those output arrays are read.
remaining_scope: This crate is a standalone SVG value and viewport adapter, not an XML tokenizer or full SVG decoder.
Shape, path, scene traversal, rendering, and whole-document SVG behavior remain outside WO-RUST-SVG-VALUES-01.
Callers remain responsible for obtaining trustworthy tokenizer attribute spans; this crate validates bounds, names, prefixes, and collection limits but does not tokenize XML.
